dossier.scp_unleashed.049.title: Plague Doctor
dossier.scp_unleashed.049.caption: SCP-049 at its surgical tray in the settlement where it was found.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-049 is to be held in a standard humanoid cell with a locked inner door. Its surgical tray may stay with it. If the tray is moved, SCP-049 follows it to the new spot.
Staff entering the cell work in pairs and keep at least three metres from SCP-049 at all times. **No one is to let SCP-049 touch them.**
Instances of SCP-049-2 are to be held apart from SCP-049 until they can be terminated. Daylight does not harm them.
If SCP-049 is loose near a settlement, residents are to be moved indoors at once. Response teams engage it together: a sustained attack makes it release whoever it is carrying.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-049 is a humanoid figure about two metres tall in a long dark robe, a wide-brimmed hat and a beaked mask with round glass lenses. The mask cannot be removed.
SCP-049 is calm and courteous. It speaks of a "Pestilence" that only it can detect, and calls itself a doctor. It greets anyone it meets with a small bow.
A single touch from SCP-049 leaves a subject weak and unable to move. It then carries the subject back to its tray and works on them with its instruments for a few seconds.
The subject does not survive. Shortly after, the body rises as an instance of SCP-049-2. Instances are slow and hostile, follow SCP-049's lead, and are not harmed by sunlight.
SCP-049 opens wooden doors and gates without difficulty, but has never broken through a wall. It is very durable and heals slowly. %rIt does not seem concerned by injury.%r

page.title: Addendum 049-1: Recovery
text: SCP-049 was found in a small farming settlement after its residents began to disappear one at a time. Its tray had been set up near the village bell.
By the time agents arrived, few residents remained. Those who had vanished were standing around the tray. SCP-049 bowed to the agents before it did anything else.

page.title: Addendum 049-2: Interview Note
text: Asked about the residents, SCP-049 said: "They were very ill. I have made them well." Asked what the Pestilence is, it said only that the agents carried it too. %rIt asked to examine them.%r
All later interviews have been held through a closed cell door, with two armed staff present and the tray left in plain sight on SCP-049's side.

page.title: Addendum 049-3: Observation Note
page.text: During a routine observation, SCP-049 broke off mid-sentence and withdrew to the far corner of its cell when a junior researcher began eating lunch at the window. It would not come forward again until the researcher had left. Asked about this afterwards, SCP-049 said only: "Some remedies are not meant for me."

A steel tray of instruments on a small stand.
SCP-049 sets this down where it works, and always comes back to it.
Set down near an SCP-049 that lost its tray, it becomes that SCP-049's new work spot.

entity.scp_unleashed.scp049.say.greet.0: Ah. Good day. I sense the Pestilence in you.
entity.scp_unleashed.scp049.say.greet.1: Please, do not be alarmed. I am a doctor.
entity.scp_unleashed.scp049.say.greet.2: You are not well. I can help you.
entity.scp_unleashed.scp049.say.touch.0: Hold still. I am the cure.
entity.scp_unleashed.scp049.say.touch.1: Do not be afraid. This will not take long.
entity.scp_unleashed.scp049.say.touch.2: There we are. Come with me.
The Pestilence will soon be gone.
Patience. My cure is always effective.
Rest now. You will be well.
I will return for you. Rest assured.
They do not understand. You are still ill.
jade.scp_unleashed.scp049.drag: Dragging a patient to its tray
SCP-049 is a polite figure in a plague doctor's robe and beaked mask. It sets down a surgery tray where it lives and always returns to it.
While no person is about, it treats the village: villagers within %s blocks of its tray are touched, held still, dragged back to the tray and operated on. Each rises as SCP-049-2.
If it sees a player or a person such as a D-Class within %s blocks, it bows, turns every SCP-049-2 it made against them and follows. Its touch leaves a person on one heart and unable to move.
A held person can be rescued: deal SCP-049 %s damage within %s seconds and it lets go. It opens wooden doors and fence gates but never breaks blocks.
It has %s health, heavy armour and slowly heals. It can be killed with sustained effort.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp049_2_spawn_eg: SCP-049-2 is what rises after SCP-049 operates. It keeps the look of the one it was, tinted green: a villager, a player's skin or a D-Class.
It has %s health and hits like a zombie for %s damage. It is slow, but sunlight does not harm it.
It guards SCP-049's tray and attacks whoever SCP-049 commands. Without SCP-049 it wanders and attacks anyone it sees.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp049_surgery_tr: SCP-049's work station. It is placed when SCP-049 is found, and every patient is brought here.
The tray can be mined with a pickaxe at any time. Place it again within 128 blocks of an SCP-049 that has lost its tray and it walks to the new spot and works there.
SCP-049 never sets down a second tray of its own. Without one it stops tending patients and grows far more dangerous. A tray placed far from any SCP-049 is just a decoration.
